authorization_instruction: continue from here to as far as you can. dont stop for reports. you know i trust in your recommendations. complete the bootstraps if possible. but if you absolutely require my input for something thats a design choice that hasnt been decided yet, then defer it and build around it - if possible.

authoring.title: The certified canonical profile preserves semantic prone-to-stance phase order
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR13.0 fixture, the symmetry-collapsed quadruped profile identifies semantic ventral-contact prone, front-pair and rear-pair distal support, the material sagittal guide, matched zero-command controls, and the only successful recovery-to-stance phase order; invalid or unavailable evidence remains UNKNOWN and the observer and phase supervisor grant no mechanical or guidance authority.
authoring.scope: Only the exact fixed profile, mirrored-pair anatomy, semantic contact roles, guide declaration, three-seed set, matched-control requirement, observer thresholds, phase order, engine, source, and BR13.0 claim scope certified by br13_20260723T225845Z_897b93c2.
authoring.mechanism: A strict profile binds semantic anatomy and contact observations to a deterministic pose observer. A separate observation-only phase supervisor checks the declared phase order and exclusive handoff without applying force or torque.
applicability: Checking the exact canonical fixture's semantic prone, transition, and terminal stance observations
Checking declared phase order and exclusive recovery-to-stance handoff for the certified profile
failure_boundaries: The material sagittal guide remains part of the fixture
Each rigid front or rear strut represents a mirrored limb pair rather than independent left-right limbs
No free-3D recovery, morphology transfer, general standing or bracing, per-foot allocation, step, gait, walking, repair, or automatic guidance is established
unknowns: Whether the phase order remains viable after the material sagittal guide is removed
How independent left-right limbs alter the observer and supervisor contract
Which pose thresholds transfer to other morphologies

authoring.title: The certified recovery ledger closes finite reserve and energy accounting
authoring.claim: In the exact certified BR13.2 fixture, the recovery ledger seals mass-gravity-height work, torque, power, and structural reserve preflight and reconciles transition-integrated positive and absorbed actuator work, mechanical-energy change, residual-inferred contact dissipation, residual-inferred guide work, and the remaining energy residual; material guide assistance, unexplained energy, external-work substitution, or insufficient reserves fail closed.
authoring.scope: Only the exact profile, actuator specification, preflight equations, post-trace energy convention, residual-inferred contact and guide terms, tolerances, engine, source, and BR13.2 claim scope certified by br13_20260723T225845Z_897b93c2.
authoring.mechanism: The pure ledger first rejects insufficient static torque, power, structural, or work reserve. It then reconciles executed actuator receipts with the observed mechanical-energy transition and bounded residual terms.
applicability: Checking finite reserve before executing the exact canonical get-up fixture
Auditing the exact transition-integrated actuator and residual-inferred energy account after execution
failure_boundaries: Contact dissipation and guide work are residual-inferred rather than direct generalized sensors
Passing the ledger does not remove the guide or prove morphology transfer, independent limbs, measured per-foot allocation, balance, bracing, a step, gait, or walking
The ledger grants no actuation, repair, automatic application, or creature guidance authority
unknowns: How the energy account changes after scaffold removal
How compliant limbs and complex feet alter residual-inferred dissipation
Which reserve margins transfer beyond the exact actuator and morphology

authoring.title: The certified fixed guided body executes a constrained planar get-up
authoring.claim: Across certified seeds 13001, 13002, and 13003, every exact BR13.4 active Godot/Jolt world begins in semantic prone, establishes ordinary paired distal support, raises whole-system center of mass by at least 0.35 m using finite paired hinge actuation with complete receipts, closes the declared energy account, hands exclusively to stance control, and completes the stable terminal dwell, while every same-state zero-command control remains prone with zero commands and actuator work.
authoring.scope: Only the exact symmetry-collapsed fixed morphology, material sagittal guide, floor, finite paired actuator, thresholds, three seeds, matched controls, 120 Hz physics rate, Godot/Jolt version, source, and BR13.4 claim scope certified by br13_20260723T225845Z_897b93c2.
authoring.mechanism: A phase-limited recovery controller issues finite paired hinge commands through the execution ledger. Live rigid-body dynamics and ordinary unilateral floor contact raise the body before an exclusive handoff to the stance controller and a declared stable dwell.
applicability: Recording that the exact fixed guided laboratory body can physically transition from prone to the declared stance dwell
Comparing the active maneuver against its exact same-state zero-command controls
failure_boundaries: The positive conclusion is exactly constrained_planar_get_up
The material sagittal guide and mirrored-pair anatomy exclude free-3D recovery and independent four-limb control

No morphology transfer, general standing, balance, bracing, fall arrest, measured per-foot allocation, load-transfer step, gait, candidate walking, walking, repair, automatic application, or creature guidance is established
unknowns: Whether the maneuver succeeds without the material sagittal guide
Whether independent four-limb actuation preserves the maneuver
Whether the result transfers to another morphology, actuator, terrain, or physics configuration
